question: In which of the following states is the ‘Eco Retreat’ festival held every year?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Odisha.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Odisha government had organized the festival's second edition** ****'Eco Retreat'**.
 
• It aims to boost tourism in the state.
 
• Compared to 2020, Odisha has added 5 more destinations to highlight the diversity in tourism and hospitality in the state for 2021.
 
• Odisha's 3-month-long event was held at 5 locations including** Konark, Hirakund, Bhitarkanika, ****Daringbadi**** and Satkosia.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Odisha:

 
 
• **Chief Minister - **Mohan Charan Majhi (BJP)
 
• **Governor - **Dr. Kambhampati Hari Babu
 
• **Number of Districts - 30.**
